source: blendMode enum of Photoshop.exe terminology; names from Photoshop.exe TransferMode ZStrings; each value set on a pixel layer and a layer group and read back (AM + DOM) by the audit, tools/ps/audit_ps.py

items.name: Normal
items.evidence: AM enum value from Photoshop.exe terminology (Enums.blendMode); display name from the Photoshop.exe ZString in extra.zstring; live 2026-10-04: set layer mode through AM (setd Lyr Trgt, DialogModes.NO) on a pixel layer and on a layer group, mode read back with executeActionGet, DOM BlendMode read back on the layer (tools/ps/audit_ps.py blend)

items.name: revert

extra.hidden: accepted and read back on a layer through Action Manager, but the DOM blendMode getter then throws 'Internal error' (no DOM BlendMode value), so it is not a mode the DOM / Layers panel exposes
